retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a profile portrait against a clear sky with a top-heavy, ultra-bold typographic header block.
triggerTerms: heavy blocky headline with profile portrait

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part composition consisting of a cream-colored top header containing massive, tightly-packed blue sans-serif text, and a lower photographic section featuring a profile portrait of a man with textured hair against a flat blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic header vs. bottom-weighted portrait
Monochromatic blue sky matching the headline color
High-contrast cream header background against the blue sky
Profile orientation facing right to lead the eye across the frame
coreInvariants: Negative space between letters is minimal (touching or near-touching)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject in the bottom two-thirds, profile view, medium-close shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive block of text at the top acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the heavy headline, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the profile gaze to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides breathing room between the dense text and the detailed portrait.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and dark hair textures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues, muted natural tones in the photography.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blue, cream, and natural portrait tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are scaled to touch or overlap slightly to create a solid block effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with a condensed version of a similar sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, slightly top-heavy weight and retro feel.
Provides the necessary blocky, high-density look if scaled horizontally.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in profile facing right, with 1970s textured hair and sideburns, against a clear, flat blue sky. Leave the top 25% of the frame as a solid cream-colored rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of ultra-bold, blue, uppercase sans-serif text in the cream header, ensuring letters are nearly touching. Add a single line of small, white, condensed uppercase text just below the header line.

verificationChecks: Is the header text ultra-bold and blue?
Is the subject in profile against a blue sky?
Is there a clear horizontal division between the header and the photo?
Is the kerning in the main title extremely tight?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not have modern drop shadows.
Check that the blue of the text matches the blue of the sky.
Verify the profile orientation is maintained.
Confirm the cream header is a solid, flat color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color] header block with [Ultra-Bold Sans-Serif] text over a [Profile Portrait] against a [Matching Color] sky.
